operations.name: haveActiveWorkflowWithTrigger
arguments:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<statemachine xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="http://static.spryker.com/state-machine-01.xsd">
    <process name="E2E Instance Lifecycle WF" main="true">
        <states>
            <state name="new" display="New"/>
            <state name="confirmed" display="Confirmed"/>
        </states>
        <transitions>
            <transition>
                <source>new</source>
                <target>confirmed</target>
                <event>confirm</event>
            </transition>
        </transitions>
        <events>
            <event name="confirm" manual="true"/>
        </events>
    </process>
</statemachine>
